NAME
    rm - Remove machine generations

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] generation rm [command options] [machine-pattern [generation-pattern|old]]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg                    - Filter by attribute (may be used more
                                        than once, default: none)
    --[no-]gc, --[no-]collect-garbage - Run nix-collect-garbage to delete
                                        unreachable store paths (default:
                                        enabled)
    -l, --[no-]local                  - List local build generations
    --max-concurrent-gc=n             - Max number of concurrent
                                        nix-collect-garbage processes (default:
                                        5)
    -r, --[no-]remote                 - List remote machine generations
    -t, --tag=arg                     - Filter by tag (may be used more than
                                        once, default: none)
    -y, --[no-]yes                    - Assume the answer to confirmations is
                                        yes
